caption: The drawing depicts a single, large teapot at the center, illustrated in pencil on a light, off-white background. The teapot has a rounded body with a wide base that tapers up to a narrower neck, flares outward, and then narrows again towards the lid. There are several horizontal bands encircling its body, neck, and lid. The spout of the teapot extends smoothly and curves outward to the left, while the handle on the opposite side is angular and ornate, curving upward and then downward with sculpted detailing. The lid of the teapot is domed with concentric ridges and is topped with a small, pointed knob, shaded slightly darker than the rest of the teapot. The entire image consists of fine pencil shading and lines, creating subtle gradients to suggest volume and depth, and is enclosed within a single rectangular border drawn in pencil. A small signature is visible in the bottom right corner.
title: Pewter Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
